name: editionguard
label: EditionGuard
description: Secure eBook DRM and fulfillment — protect and deliver EPUB, MOBI, and PDF files with Adobe DRM, Readium LCP, or Social DRM.

token.label: API Token
token.description:
Your EditionGuard API token.

**How to get your API token:**
1. Log in to your [EditionGuard dashboard](https://app.editionguard.com)
2. Go to **Settings** (top-bar menu)
3. Find the **API** section and copy your **Rest API Token**

send_ebook_download_links.label: Send eBook Download Links
send_ebook_download_links.description: Creates a transaction for an eBook and sends the download link(s) to your customer. Returns the download link you can deliver by email or any other channel.

resource_id.label: eBook
resource_id.description: Select the eBook to send to your customer.

customer_email.label: Customer Email
customer_email.description: The customer's email address where the download instructions will be sent.

order_number.label: Order Number
order_number.description: Your order or transaction reference number (e.g. from your eCommerce platform). Used for tracking and reporting.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.description: Number of download links to generate. Use 1 for a single copy. Increase for multi-seat or multi-device licenses.

watermark_name.label: Customer's Full Name (Social DRM)
watermark_name.description: Only applies when the eBook uses **Social DRM (EditionMark)**. The customer's name will be embedded as a visible watermark in the eBook. Leave empty for Adobe DRM or Readium LCP books.

watermark_email.label: Customer's Email for Watermark (Social DRM)
watermark_email.description: Only applies when the eBook uses **Social DRM (EditionMark)**. This email will be embedded as a watermark. Leave empty for Adobe DRM or Readium LCP books.

watermark_phone.label: Customer's Phone for Watermark (Social DRM)
watermark_phone.description: Only applies when the eBook uses **Social DRM (EditionMark)**. This phone number will be embedded as a watermark. Leave empty for Adobe DRM or Readium LCP books.
